name: audit
description: Three-agent read-only audit with independent review angles and compact synthesis.

parallel.label: Correctness and runtime
parallel.task:
Audit this target for correctness and runtime defects: {task}

Inspect repository instructions, the relevant diff, source, callers, tests, configuration, and error/cleanup/concurrency paths. Where applicable, verify compatibility, migrations, deployment or ordering assumptions, rollback, cleanup, and failure recovery. Report only evidence-backed defects with precise locations, failure scenarios, smallest safe fixes, and validation. Do not edit files. Keep the receipt compact.

parallel.label: Tests, simplicity, and applicable security
parallel.task:
Independently audit this target for tests, simplicity, and applicable security: {task}

Look for missing regression or characterization coverage, unnecessary complexity, brittle integration seams, and security issues only where the change exposes a real trust boundary. Inspect the actual diff, source, tests, documentation, changelog or migration notes, configuration, and operational checks where release scope requires them. Report only evidence-backed defects or material validation gaps with precise locations and smallest safe fixes. Do not edit files. Keep the receipt compact.

chain.label: Synthesize audit
